description: This file provides an API client for the WristFit frontend, allowing communication with a backend hand-detection API. It includes functions to get the API base URL and to perform hand detection requests with image data.

methods.name: getApiBase()
methods.description: Returns the configured API base URL from environment variables or an empty string for same-origin.

methods.name: handDetect(imageBase64, preferExternal = true, timeoutMs = 25000)
methods.description: Calls the /api/hand-detect endpoint with a base64 image string, manages request timeout, and returns detection data such as landmarks, segmentation mask, confidence, provider, width, and height.

ctags.name: handDetect
ctags.pattern: /^export async function handDetect(imageBase64, preferExternal = true, timeoutMs = 25000) {$/
